meta.name: Black Rabbit
meta.description: A rising-star restaurateur is forced into New York's criminal underworld when his chaotic brother returns to town with loan sharks on his trail.

videos.title: The Cyclone
videos.overview: Awaiting a make-or-break visit from a food critic, restaurateur Jake Friedken is thrown off-center by the return of his troublesome brother, Vince.

videos.title: The Black Rabbits
videos.overview: Riding high, Jake begins to dream of a second restaurant — until a financial curveball puts both him and Vince in jeopardy with their creditors.

videos.title: Skin Contact
videos.overview: When Jake and Vince throw a lavish last-minute fundraiser, Roxie suspects an ulterior motive. A disgruntled former employee rears his head.

videos.title: No More F**k-Ups
videos.overview: Jake scrambles to conceal the truth after a reporter starts snooping around the Rabbit. A moment of overconfidence puts Vince in even deeper danger.

videos.title: Trailblazer
videos.overview: When Junior and Babbit turn up the heat, the brothers respond in kind. Roxie appeals to Wes to make changes at the restaurant.

videos.title: Attaf**kinboy
videos.overview: As deals, debts and double-crosses intensify, all roads lead to one fateful night at the Rabbit.

videos.title: These Kids Nearly Got Munsoned
videos.overview: A furious Mancuso vows to settle the score with Vince. Jake faces tough questions from every direction. Estelle wrestles with guilt.

videos.title: Isle of Joy
videos.overview: With threats closing in on all sides, the brothers make a final bid for survival that brings them face-to-face with their complicated past.

meta.slogan: How far would you go for family?
